newForms.name: Duneglop
newForms.lore: Rolls itself into every dune at sunset, just to feel the sand cool.

newForms.name: Glazeback
newForms.lore: The desert sun baked its back into a shell of glass, and it wears the cracks proudly.

newForms.name: Glasshide
newForms.lore: Its whole hide has fused to glass now; it chimes softly with every step.

newForms.name: Sandglass
newForms.lore: Legends say it counts the desert's centuries one grain at a time.

newForms.name: Frostdown
newForms.lore: Puffs up twice its size when the first snow falls, mostly to look important.

newForms.name: Icecomb
newForms.lore: Its comb froze mid-crow one winter and simply never thawed back.

newForms.name: Glacialwing
newForms.lore: Glides on wings of packed frost, leaving a trail of glittering powder.

newForms.name: Frostmantle
newForms.lore: Wears the first snowfall of every winter like a cloak, and never lets it melt.

newForms.name: Cinderwing
newForms.lore: Leaves a trail of drifting embers wherever it flies, and insists it is not showing off.

newForms.name: Charhawk
newForms.lore: Finally looks like the hawk it always claimed to be, wreathed in curling smoke.

newForms.name: Scarhawk
newForms.lore: Nests in the hottest cliffs of the Ember Scar and dares anything to complain about the heat.

newForms.name: Ashphoenix
newForms.lore: When it finally rests, it settles into its own ashes and calls it a nap.

newForms.name: Duskhop
newForms.lore: Waits for the sky to purple before it dares to leave its burrow.

newForms.name: Nightspring
newForms.lore: Leaps between shadows so quickly the moths lose track of it.

newForms.name: Voidhare
newForms.lore: Its shadow moves a half-second before it does, and neither ever explains why.

newForms.name: Eclipsehare
newForms.lore: Only shows itself during a full eclipse, and grants one perfect wish of silence.

newForms.name: Bogling
newForms.lore: Croaks in three different pitches and none of them are reassuring.

newForms.name: Mudlurker
newForms.lore: Waits so still in the mud that herons mistake it for a log, once.

newForms.name: Bogmaw
newForms.lore: Its throat-pouch glows just enough to lure curious will-o'-wisps close.

newForms.name: Miredredge
newForms.lore: Every lantern in Mistveil Marsh dims a little when it finally surfaces.

newForms.name: Dustpaw
newForms.lore: Kicks up a small sandstorm every time it pounces, entirely on purpose.

newForms.name: Sandlynx
newForms.lore: Its tufted ears can hear a beetle shift under three feet of sand.

newForms.name: Dunestalker
newForms.lore: Stalks the dune ridges at dusk, leaving perfectly tidy pawprints and no warning at all.

newForms.name: Sandmane
newForms.lore: Its mane holds the whole day's heat, so the pride always naps in its shadow instead.

prompts.name: Sandgloop
prompts.prompt: A squat, sand-colored blob with a lumpy, granular hide like packed dune-sand, small round eyes, and a faint ripple where it oozes; warm ochre-gold body fading paler at its underside.

prompts.name: Duneglop
prompts.prompt: A larger, rounder sand blob with visible wind-ripple ridges across its back and tiny sand-grain sparkles catching the light; the same ochre-gold hue as before but with a subtly hardening, sun-cracked crust starting to form along its top.

prompts.name: Glazeback
prompts.prompt: A broad sand blob whose upper crust has fused into a warm amber-glass shell, sun-glazed cracks glowing faintly along its spine, still soft and wobbling underneath the hardened dome; richer bronze-gold coloring.

prompts.name: Glasshide
prompts.prompt: A humanoid-postured glass-sand golem, its entire body now a thick smoky-amber glass carapace over a soft ochre core glowing dimly within, faceted shoulder ridges, pale glassy highlights catching the light like heat-shimmer.

prompts.name: Sandglass
prompts.prompt: A towering desert colossus entirely encased in deep bronze-amber glass, ornate hourglass-shaped ridges spiraling down its body, glowing pale blue-white cracks of trapped light threading through its glass hide like frozen lightning, a commanding, ancient silhouette.

prompts.name: Frostpeck
prompts.prompt: A round, fluffy snow-white chicken with thick powder-blue down, tiny stub wings, bright button eyes, and a dusting of frost crystals across its back like sugar.

prompts.name: Frostdown
prompts.prompt: A larger, puffier snow chicken with a thick ring of frost-blue down around its neck like a ruff, small icy specks glinting on its wingtips, the same round cheerful silhouette but plumper.

prompts.name: Icecomb
prompts.prompt: A proud frost hen with a crystalline pale-blue ice comb curling atop its head like frozen fire, frost-down cascading down its neck, deepening sky-blue plumage.

prompts.name: Glacialwing
prompts.prompt: A sleek glacier-blue bird with wide frost-feathered wings edged in sharp ice crystals, its ice comb now a jagged crown, pale glowing frost patterns tracing its feathers.

prompts.name: Frostmantle
prompts.prompt: A majestic snow bird with an enormous trailing mantle of frozen plumage that shimmers like an aurora, deep glacier-blue body, glowing icy-white cracks of light threading through its crest and wings, a regal, wind-swept final form.

prompts.name: Ashwing
prompts.prompt: A small round bird with dark charcoal-red feathers and glowing ember-orange wingtips, tiny smoke wisps trailing from its tail, bright eager eyes, a chick-like silhouette that still insists on looking fierce.

prompts.name: Cinderwing
prompts.prompt: A sleeker soot-red bird with longer ember-orange flight feathers that leave a faint trail of drifting sparks, a slightly sharper beak, the same dark ash body deepening toward charcoal.

prompts.name: Charhawk
prompts.prompt: A proper hawk-shaped bird now, charcoal-black plumage licked with curling smoke, fierce orange eyes, its wingtips smoldering like dying coals, a hooked beak and confident predator stance.

prompts.name: Scarhawk
prompts.prompt: A battle-worn ash hawk with jagged charcoal feathers and cracked, glowing ember seams along its wings, talons wreathed in low flame, a scar-like streak of bright orange across one wing.

prompts.name: Ashphoenix
prompts.prompt: A magnificent ash-black phoenix with a long trailing tail of curling smoke and molten-orange flame, wings edged in bright glowing cinder-light, glowing cracks of fire threading through its charcoal plumage like a creature reborn from its own ashes.

prompts.name: Moonhop
prompts.prompt: A slender indigo-violet hare with oversized ears fading to pale lavender at the tips, faint glowing moon-shaped markings along its haunches, huge dark eyes reflecting starlight.

prompts.name: Duskhop
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger violet hare with longer ears trailing wisps of shadow, its moon-marking now a soft glowing crescent on its forehead, deepening indigo fur with a faint starry dust across its back.

prompts.name: Nightspring
prompts.prompt: A lean, coiled-for-leaping hare with smoky violet fur and ghostly translucent afterimages trailing its powerful hind legs, glowing lavender crescent markings now running down both flanks.

prompts.name: Voidhare
prompts.prompt: A tall, rangy hare wrapped in near-black void fur, its ears long ribbons of drifting shadow, glowing violet eclipse-rings circling each eye, a faint star-flecked aura shimmering around its silhouette.

prompts.name: Eclipsehare
prompts.prompt: A towering, regal void hare cloaked in deep black-violet fur that fades into starry mist at the edges, a luminous eclipse-ring crown hovering above its head, glowing lavender-white light bleeding from cracks along its long ears and haunches.

prompts.name: Mirecroak
prompts.prompt: A squat, murky-green bog frog with a dark violet throat sac that pulses faintly, warty mottled skin, and wide glowing amber eyes half-lidded in the muck.

prompts.name: Bogling
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger swamp frog with deeper moss-green skin and thicker warts along its back, a bigger violet throat pouch that glows softly when it croaks, faint purple mist curling from its nostrils.

prompts.name: Mudlurker
prompts.prompt: A broad, low-crouching bog toad caked in dried mud plates, its violet throat glow now spreading in faint veins across its chest, murky green skin darkening toward black at the edges.

prompts.name: Bogmaw
prompts.prompt: A hulking swamp toad with an enormous glowing violet throat pouch and wide lantern-lure eyes, cracked mud-armor skin, faint wisps of purple vapor drifting from its wide mouth.

prompts.name: Miredredge
prompts.prompt: A colossal ancient bog king wreathed in dripping moss and near-black swamp hide, its chest ablaze with a massive glowing violet lantern-throat, faint ghostly will-o'-wisp lights orbiting its hunched, moss-crowned silhouette.

prompts.name: Dunecat
prompts.prompt: A small sand-gold cat with faint darker tabby stripes, tufted ear-tips, a stubby tail, and sleepy half-lidded eyes, dozing in a curl of warm dune-colored fur.

prompts.name: Dustpaw
prompts.prompt: A leaner sand-gold cat with slightly longer legs and dusty paw-tufts that puff sand with every step, sharper tabby markings, alert amber eyes.

prompts.name: Sandlynx
prompts.prompt: A rangy desert lynx with long tufted ears, a short bobbed tail, deepening tan-gold fur with bold dark stripes down its back, powerful haunches built for pouncing.

prompts.name: Dunestalker
prompts.prompt: A lean, muscular desert predator cat with a low prowling stance, burnt-amber fur streaked in dark bands, glowing pale eyes, a small sand-toned mane starting to form at its neck and shoulders.

prompts.name: Sandmane
prompts.prompt: A majestic sand-lion with a huge sun-gold mane that ripples like heat-shimmer, richly burnished amber fur, powerful shoulders, glowing warm-gold eyes, an unmistakably regal, sun-crowned desert guardian silhouette.
